manifest.title: Starter assistant
manifest.description: Summarize supplied input and suggest a next step with an ordinary inference node. No automatic GitHub effects.

manifest.title: Implementation workflow
manifest.description: Plan a supplied task, implement a focused change and assess verification with a bounded repair loop of ordinary nodes. No commits, pushes, pull requests or labels.

manifest.title: Review workflow
manifest.description: Review a supplied change with separate fresh reviewer and fixer turns, then review again within a bounded cycle of ordinary nodes. No pushes, GitHub approvals, labels or merges.

manifest.title: QA assessment
manifest.description: Define criteria, assess supplied evidence and challenge the assessment with separate fresh turns in ordinary nodes. No GitHub effects, authenticated proof or enforced evidence isolation.
